compiler: ccv1 (with OLD_D53 since 2026-11-24, for nlist of libc-v9)

main.note: as System III, with the table of getnmount (M, Mp, nmount: names guessed) instead of M[NMOUNT] and the division of the read count.

printit.note: WEGA: no ustat; the free blocks counted with alloc in both branches, sync first.

alloc.note: WEGA: (long)b >= (long)sblock.s_fsize (not under SHIPPED): the original compares signed, daddr_t of the sys/param.h of WEGA is unsigned long; an older param.h with long is likely (a guess), the cast gives the bytes.

getnmount.note: name guessed (no symbols); written from the code: nlist("/wega") of _Nmount, read from /dev/kmem, calloc of the table; the test after calloc is mp == 0 (the parameter, not *mp: a bug of the original, kept).

note: libc-v9.a: calloc 0_2 (the System III calloc with size declared int, not unsigned: num *= size takes size from r6, 2026-11-24), nlist 0_1 (ccv1 with OLD_D53: no return temporary in nlist, its frame over 1250 bytes; readby keeps it), stat, sync. The corpus is thin: the emulator has no /dev/kmem (increment 162).
